audit_items.proof_trace: Race condition between parallel goroutines: validateStateTransition calls ProcessPayload→SetLatestExecutionPayloadHeader (L222 in payload.go) caching the header, while validateExecutionOnBlock calls notifyNewPayload for engine validation. No ordering guarantee ensures execution validation completes before state caching, violating the precondition that execution engine must validate before CL caches.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends malicious block via P2P with invalid execution payload. Due to errgroup parallel execution (receive_block.go:218-236), state transition goroutine can cache the invalid header via SetLatestExecutionPayloadHeader before the execution engine goroutine completes validation and rejects it, leaving state corrupted with invalid payload header.
